shortDescription: Queries and returns elements from Infrahub GraphQL API

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: Endpoint of the Infrahub API, optional env=INFRAHUB_ADDRESS

options.name: branch
options.description: Branch in which the request is made

options.name: graph_variables
options.description: Dictionary of keys/values to pass into the GraphQL query

options.name: query
options.description: GraphQL query parameters or filters to send to Infrahub to obtain desired data

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout for Infrahub requests in seconds

options.name: token
options.description: The API token created through Infrahub, optional env=INFRAHUB_API_TOKEN

options.name: update_hostvars
options.description: Whether or not to populate data in the in the root (example hostvars[inventory_hostname]) or within the 'data' key (example `hostvars[inventory_hostname]['data']`). Beware, that the root keys provided by the query will overwrite any root keys already present, leverage the GraphQL alias feature to avoid issues.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL of the Infrahub instance
